thread:
Carmen (Finance Ops): MeterMark sent a renewal + new tier proposal that mixes committed tokens, seat bundles, and a per-route surcharge for high-throughput endpoints. Can procurement/eng/legal gatecheck before I reply?
Eli (Procurement): Snapshot of asks: 1) seat vs usage cost tradeoffs at our Q4 baseline, 2) migration/transfer credits, 3) invoice + PO flow (Net30), 4) cancellation window and refund policy.
Diego (Platform): Our numbers: 3mo avg = 490M tokens/mo, 95th = 810M. We have two heavy routes (/api/generate and /api/embeddings) that account for ~60% of tokens. Need per-route or per-api-key attribution and a webhook sample.
Theo (MeterMark Sales): Quick TL;DR from our side. Tiers: SEAT_50 (50 seats + 200M tokens) = $2,200/mo, COMMIT_600 = $3,200/mo, COMMIT_1B = $5,000/mo. PAYG = $0.009/1k tokens. Seat bundles intended for low-token/high-seat teams. Migration credit: up to 15% of first-year commit applied monthly for 12-month commits. Annual prepay gets 10% off. Overage billed at PAYG but can be discounted 12% if you hit >110% of commit in a month.
Theo (MeterMark Sales): Sample usage webhook: POST /hooks/usage 
{ "customer": "rw-555", "time": "2025-10-14T09:02:11Z", "tokens": 1520, "api_key": "svc-prod-1", "route": "/api/generate", "request_id": "r_77e1" }
Diego (Platform): Good. Does the webhook include a hashed request body or only meta? We prefer no PII; hashed payload ok. Also need a monthly CSV export we can join in our billing reconciler.
Theo (MeterMark Sales): Webhook only includes metadata by default. Raw payload capture is an opt-in enterprise feature (can be disabled). CSV export endpoint: /billing/exports?month=YYYY-MM returns a signed CSV.
Marta (Legal): Legal asks: data retention for raw payloads, ability to purge on termination, DPA and subprocessors, no auto-renew longer than 30 days without written consent, and termination penalty caps.
Theo (MeterMark Sales): Standard retention: raw request bodies retained 45 days, billing metadata 7 years. We can add purge on termination clause and provide DPA + SOC2 Type II on request. Termination: standard 60-day notice; prepaid refunds only with enterprise addendum.
Eli (Procurement): Please provide: - itemized SKU list (commit, seat, overage, support, SLA add-on) - sample invoice (Net30, PO field) - confirmation if annual prepay allowed and refund policy - any minimum term for discounted overages
Theo (MeterMark Sales): I'll upload an itemized quote + sample invoice PDF and an SKU mapping (e.g., MM_COMMIT_600, MM_SEAT_50, MM_OVR_PAYG, MM_SUPPORT_P1). Annual prepay yes, with 10% off; refunds limited per contract.
Carmen (Finance Ops): If COMMIT_600 hits our baseline (avg ~490M), we might save ~900-1,300/mo vs PAYG. Need Eli to run a 3y cashflow TCO comparing monthly commit vs annual prepay. Also confirm how migration credit phases in.
Eli (Procurement): I'll run TCO and share a short spreadsheet. Can we get a 30m sync with MeterMark next Wed 9am PT? @Theo ok?
Theo (MeterMark Sales): Wed 9am PT works. I'll send calendar invite and attach quote, sample invoice, DPA, webhook schema, and CSV export spec by EOD Thursday.
Marta (Legal): Please include explicit wording on purge-on-termination and subprocessor list in the packet.
Diego (Platform): Once I get webhook spec + CSV sample I'll run a quick ingestion test and confirm route attribution.
Carmen (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone 44d we'll circle back after the quote and TCO.
